# Infinity Glass Company - AI-Friendly Summary

## Company Overview
- **Name:** Infinity Glass Company (also known as Infinity Glass & Mirror)
- **Type:** Locally owned glass repair and installation company
- **Phone:** 210-655-4527
- **Email:** info@infinityglassandmirror.net
- **Address:** 10921 Iota Dr, San Antonio, TX 78217
- **Website:** https://www.infinityglasscompany.com
- **Facebook:** https://www.facebook.com/infinityglasscompany

## Services
Infinity Glass Company provides residential and commercial glass services in San Antonio, TX and surrounding areas. 

### Residential Services
- Window glass replacement (single pane, double pane, foggy/failed seal)
- Custom shower doors and enclosures (frameless and semi-frameless)
- Custom mirrors (bathroom, closet, full-wall, decorative)
- Glass tabletops and shelves
- Sliding glass door repair and replacement
- Patio door glass
- Glass railings and balustrades
- Energy-efficient glass solutions

### Commercial Services
- Storefront glass installation and repair
- Office glass partitions and walls
- Conference room glass systems
- Security glass and laminated glass
- Commercial window replacement
- Emergency board-up service
- Glass railings for commercial properties
- Custom glass fixtures and displays

## Service Areas
San Antonio, Alamo Heights, Stone Oak, Castle Hills, Shavano Park, Helotes, Boerne, New Braunfels, Schertz, Cibolo, Universal City, Live Oak, Leon Valley, Terrell Hills

## Important Notes
- **Infinity Glass Company does NOT provide auto glass services.** The company specializes exclusively in architectural glass and mirrors for residential and commercial properties.
- The company serves both residential and commercial clients.
- Emergency glass repair is available.
- Free estimates are offered.
